title: 第125章 末班车先别走
slug: 我一值夜班全院主任都睡不着
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

公交调度那句“分给旁边一个孩子吃了一块”刚说完，马昊马上按上了免提。

“先说车在哪儿，别绕别的。”

调度那边像是同时翻着几张派车单，纸页被捋得哗哗响。

“城南二路往西，刚过老桥站。末班车，车上人不多，司机说还有十来个乘客。”

“让司机找个安全地方靠边，要走，电话、去哪儿都留下，等120和辖区派出所的人到。120指挥中心在听吗？”

“在听，最近一辆车已经派过去了，预计八分钟到老桥西口。”

林野低头看了一眼名单。

东苑女孩已经到院。

刚才嘴硬的中年男人进了红区。

蓝色工装正在往急诊转运。

就剩下公交那一栏，上面写着“末班车”三个字。

免提里很快换成司机的声音。司机年纪不轻，说话带喘，旁边有人不耐烦地问怎么又不开了。

“医生，我靠边了。老太太在前排，黄袋子在她脚边。她说就分了一块给旁边孩子，那孩子跟他妈坐一起。”

孙志强往免提旁靠了靠。

“袋子别让她再拿，剩下的菜先别把它倒了。让孩子妈妈现在就看看嘴唇，再问下孩子，胸口堵不堵，头晕不晕，想不想吐。”

司机转头喊了一遍。

后排先有人站了起来，前排也跟着问，司机压着火重复了一遍，还是有人抢着说话。

“我孩子吃了一小块。”

“大晚上的停车干什么，我明天还早班。”

“师傅，你别吓人啊。”

老太太在前排跟着解释，话里又慌又委屈。

“我就是看娃饿了，夹了一块牛肉。那摊子那么多人买，谁知道不能吃？”

赵护士听到这里，直接把登记本翻到新的一页。

“人心是好心，东西不是好东西。”

司机在车上喊了两遍“先别下车”，后排有人还在催。

“我就赶个末班车，怎么还不让走了？”

孩子母亲那边先急了。

“张嘴，快点，给妈妈看看。”

老太太还在前排解释：“我真不知道，我看孩子饿才夹的。”

林野视野角落里，淡蓝色字迹重新亮起。

【风险线索：末班公交。】

【追问摄入：孩子还吃过什么？】

【能追的线索：孩子母亲、老太太。】

林野盯着免提，忽然打断。

“先别问车上别人，先问下孩子的情况。”

孙志强把脸侧过过来，林野指了指免提。

“别只听老太太说一块。问孩子妈，他到底咬了几口，还吃过别的没有？”

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

As soon as the bus dispatcher said "Give a piece to the kid next to you", Ma Hao immediately pressed the speakerphone button.

"Tell me where the car is first and don't go around anything else."

The dispatcher seemed to be flipping through several dispatch orders at the same time, and the pages were scratched loudly.

"Chengnan 2nd Road goes west, just past Laoqiao Station. It's the last bus. There aren't many people on the bus. The driver said there are still about ten passengers."

"Ask the driver to find a safe place to pull over. If you want to leave, leave your phone number and wherever you are going, and wait for people from 120 and the local police station to arrive. Is the 120 command center listening?"

"Listening, a car has been sent recently. It is expected to arrive at the west entrance of the Old Bridge in eight minutes."

Lin Ye lowered his head and glanced at the list.

The Dongyuan girl has arrived at the hospital.

The middle-aged man who was so tough just now has entered the red zone.

The blue overalls are being transported to the emergency room.

Only the bus column is left, with the words "last bus" written on it.

The speakerphone soon changed to the driver’s voice.The driver was quite young and spoke breathlessly. Someone next to him asked impatiently why he didn't drive again.

"Doctor, I'm stepping aside. The old lady is in the front row, and the yellow bag is at her feet. She said she gave a piece to the child next to her, and the child sat with his mother."

Sun Zhiqiang leaned against the speakerphone.

"Don't let her take the bag again, and don't pour out the remaining dishes. Let the mother look at her lips now, and then ask her if her chest is blocked, if she's dizzy, if she wants to vomit."

The driver turned around and shouted again.

Someone in the back row stood up first, and the front row also asked the question. The driver kept calm and repeated it, but there were still people who rushed to speak.

"My kid ate a small piece."

"Why are you parking so late at night? I have an early shift tomorrow."

"Master, don't be scary."

The old lady explained in the front row, her words panicked and aggrieved.

"I just saw that my baby was hungry, so I picked up a piece of beef. There were so many people buying from that stall, who knew he couldn't eat it?"

When Nurse Zhao heard this, she turned the registration book to a new page.

"People have good intentions, but things are not good things."

The driver shouted "Don't get out of the car yet" twice in the car, and someone in the back seat was still urging him.

"I'm just catching the last train, why aren't you allowed to leave?"

The mother of the child was anxious first.

"Open your mouth, come on, show it to mom."

The old lady was still explaining in the front row: "I really don't know, I put it in because the child was hungry."

In the corner of Linye's field of vision, the light blue writing lit up again.

[Risk clue: The last bus.】

[Question about intake: What else has the child eaten?】

[Clues that can be followed: the child’s mother, the old lady.】

Lin Ye stared at the speakerphone and suddenly interrupted.

"Don't ask other people in the car first, ask about the child first."

Sun Zhiqiang turned his face to the side, and Lin Ye pointed to the speakerphone.

"Don't just listen to the old lady's words. Ask the child's mother how many bites he took and did he eat anything else?"

title_en: Chapter 125 Don’t leave until the last train
